summary: This directory manages the core logic for analyzing source directories and generating architectural metadata, providing the necessary tools to construct, validate, and test directory concepts within the system.
responsibilities: Analyze project file structures to derive architectural properties
Construct and validate directory concept metadata
Provide testing infrastructure for verifying architectural analysis logic
Manage paths and storage for architectural metadata records
relationships: The internal analysis logic generates directory concepts based on file summaries.
Test suites validate the accuracy of the conceptualization logic against architectural definitions.
Metadata management utilities facilitate the storage and resolution of generated concepts.
designDecisions: Encapsulation of analysis logic within an internal namespace
Co-location of testing suites with functional modules
Automated persistence of metadata into dedicated project structures
Separation of concerns between file summarization and directory-level concept aggregation
